description: A few weeks ago at the National Conference of State Legislatures, Representative Ricks sat down with NCSL officials to talk about the issues shaping her district right now — from oil and gas development to HOA reform — and what's ahead as she heads into her fourth term at the State Capitol.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Naquetta Ricks for Colorado
title: Rep. Ricks Talks HD40 Priorities and the Road to 2027 — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
